meta.title: Poi — make your app look like a product people know
meta.description: A skill for Claude Code. Say "make it Google-ish" and Poi rewrites the screens of your repository in that product's style: color, spacing and wording.

lead: Poi rewrites the screens of your repository,
down to the wording on buttons and errors.

showcase.caption: The same sample app, rewritten by Poi for each company.

install.title: Get started.
install.body: Run these two lines, then say "Make it Google-ish" in Claude Code.

features.title: Measured from the real screens
features.body: Colors, sizes and the way each company words buttons and errors.

features.title: Behavior stays
features.body: Data, saving and navigation are untouched. Logos and names are never copied.

features.title: Every width, dark mode too
features.body: Keeps your layouts at 1280, 768 and 375px, and your dark mode if you have one.
